themes.title: Anthropic mega-IPO targets $1.4tn
themes.summary: Anthropic is aiming for a valuation of up to $1.4tn in its IPO, raising as much as $64bn, and bankers are already preparing to lift the target to $1.5tn or more on strong demand. Goldman Sachs projects revenue above $600bn by 2030, and early investors are shopping allocations at a premium ahead of the largest public listing on record.
themes.angle: The public markets are about to set the benchmark price for all of AI.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO crisis deepens over China ties
themes.summary: Nvidia has brought in a former US prosecutor from Wachtell to lead an internal investigation into CEO Jensen Huang, while the US Commerce Department delays blacklisting a company linked to the alleged spy at the centre of the affair. Reuters reports widening scrutiny of Nvidia China chip ties; Axios argues the political backlash could force the AI slowdown that industry leaders could not self-impose.
themes.angle: Key-person and export-policy risk now sit on the same Nvidia balance sheet.

themes.title: HUMAIN lands $667M for Saudi AI infra
themes.summary: PIF-backed HUMAIN and Saudi Infra signed $667m in financing agreements to advance Saudi Arabia AI infrastructure, supporting up to 1GW of data-centre capacity. The deal was reported in concert by Arabian Business, Asharq Al-Awsat, ZAWYA, TradeArabia and Fast Company Middle East - a rare regional consensus on a single financing event.
themes.angle: Saudi is financing AI compute like infrastructure debt - not venture equity.

themes.title: OpenAI Q3 revenue hits $10B
themes.summary: OpenAI crossed $10bn in quarterly revenue for the first time in the three months ending September, up nearly 50%, on demand for its newest software. It also launched ChatGPT for Businesses, letting companies manage their public presence and convert interest inside the product.
themes.angle: Frontier-lab revenue is converging on SaaS economics at unprecedented scale.

themes.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 hits factory floor
themes.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, aimed at physical intelligence for industrial work. In a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot it scored 96% sorting metal parts, and Ars Technica frames the release as the lab's most consequential robotics step yet.
themes.angle: Physical AI is moving from demos into manufacturing acceptance criteria.

themes.title: AI capex check: SoftBank, CoreWeave
themes.summary: SoftBank posted its first net loss in nearly two years - $7bn - after a $3.7bn writedown on US data-centre projects. CoreWeave countered the narrative by raising its annual forecast and planning a multibillion-dollar chip-backed debt deal, while US regulators postponed trading in AI computing futures over manipulation concerns.
themes.angle: The financing layer of the AI buildout is where the risk now lives.

themes.title: DeepMind verifies Signal with Gemini
themes.summary: Google DeepMind used AI agents to formally verify core guarantees of the Signal protocol, publicly proving parts of its encryption after roughly four weeks of machine-driven work. Axios calls it a step toward hacker-proof software; WIRED and The Register cover the human-AI verification setup.
themes.angle: AI proving its own security stack is a new enterprise trust milestone.

themes.title: UAE-Saudi AI policy and compute watch
themes.summary: Abu Dhabi's Crown Prince approved a 2026-2031 National Genomics Masterplan, and Abu Dhabi said AI and flexible energy tech lifted system efficiency over 10%. Abu Dhabi AI firm AIQ partnered on AI-powered offshore security, and the UAE joined a children's AI-safety declaration. AGBI reads Wall Street's growing Gulf-SWF ties as a structural shift in AI capital flows.
themes.angle: GCC AI policy is compounding daily: genomics, energy, security, safety.
